scope: TRAIN-only diagnostic used once to route the optional X policy; no candidate checkpoint or rollout outcome may be read

common_reference.shared_parameter_scope: all and only parameter paths matching .*lora.*
common_reference.auxiliary_head: the existing mean-first-27-hidden PhysicalAuxiliaryHead, at the same seed42 initialization for both targets
common_reference.contact_target: u_c^VAC from the frozen B2 sidecar
common_reference.vision_target: u_v^VAC from the frozen B3 cache

gradient_batches.per_batch: 16 current-contact-active and 16 current-contact-free rows, sampled without replacement
gradient_batches.current_contact_active: any of five tactile_sim occupancy channels exceeds 0.5
gradient_batches.empty_group: NA for that batch and excluded from group medians

gradient_metrics.interpretation: negative cosine is interference evidence only, not closed-loop causality

p4.row_selection: five evenly spaced valid rows in row order from every episode
p4.hidden_source: first 27 action hidden positions from the same exact untrained common reference
p4.mean_features: mean over 27 positions followed by a fixed Gaussian 1024-to-648 projection
p4.order_features: each position receives the same fixed Gaussian 1024-to-24 projection, then the 27 projected positions are concatenated in order
p4.head: TRAIN-standardized ridge to flattened u_c^VAC, alpha=0.001
p4.route_threshold: relative normalized-MSE improvement >= 0.10 and paired absolute-improvement CI lower bound > 0

route.BLOCKED_TEACHER: teacher_policy_domain_audit status is not PASS, vision_contact_gradient_provenance status is not PASS, teacher_comparability is not PASS_WITH_LIMITATION with PACKAGE_LEVEL_TEACHER_COMPARISON_ONLY, or either B2/VAC-V target audit is not PASS
route.C_REBALANCE: at least two allowed reference groups have cos(g_pi,g_C)<0 in more than half their nonempty fixed batches and median lambda_C*norm(g_C)/(norm(g_pi)+epsilon)>0.5
route.C_ORDER: P4 meets its frozen relative-improvement and paired-CI threshold
route.C_JOINT: u_c and u_v each beat TRAIN-mean overall by at least 10%, and u_c beats u_v by at least 5% on at least one v2 boundary/dynamic event-or-trend metric, while each different-episode mismatch error exceeds its matched overall error by at least 10%
route.NOT_RUN_NOT_JUSTIFIED: none of the preceding routes passes
